about: Every foreground/background token pair the site actually draws. check:contrast verifies each in day and night. min 4.5 = body and UI text (WCAG 1.4.3 AA); 3 = UI components, focus ring and graphical objects (WCAG 1.4.11). --contour is decorative only (contour lines, rules between content) and is deliberately absent: it never carries text, meaning or a control boundary.
